title: Rav Kahana bar Matityah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 8b, according to the reading of Dikdukei Soferim, and our reading there is "bar Meniyumi," but the reading of the Yuchasin was "bar Mattityah," and so it is in the Or Zarua, siman 114; and in Menachot 66b: "Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa objected to Rav Kahana bar Mattityah."

notes.text: The consulted Eruvin 8b reads bar Minyomi. In the consulted Menachot 66b, bar Matityah is parenthesized in the account of Tachlifa’s objection. Hyman reports the other edition readings.
